name: My Genius Girl
overview: Qiao Ning was an orphan, adopted by Dai Huaimin at the age of six. She thought she had a father and a home, but when Dai's biological daughter returned, she was sent to prison, only to be told, "Qiao Ning, you are ultimately not my biological daughter." Since that was the case, she went to find her biological father, the most mysterious bigwig in the Luzhou entertainment circle—He Junru. However, the bigwig was cold-hearted and didn't know how to raise children.
